title: Linear Invariance of the H-Transform Support Span
summary: For nonstandard H, the full H-transform lacks the relevant linear equivariance, but whether the span of its support remains linear invariant is unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For $H\not\sim H_0$, is $V_f:=\operatorname{span}(\operatorname{supp}(\widehat f^{\,H}))$ invariant under linear equivalence of $f$?

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis using generalized Simon algorithms and Hadamard transforms of Boolean functions.
assumptions: The Hadamard matrix H is not equivalent to the standard matrix H0.
parameters: H: the Hadamard matrix defining the transform
f: the Boolean function being transformed
V_f: the span of the support of the H-transform of f
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether V_f is invariant under linear equivalence of f.

citations.label: Simon's Algorithm and Symmetric Crypto: Generalizations and Automatized Applications

progress.summary: The paper notes that Theorem 2 rules out the stated equivariance of the full H-transform but does not establish non-invariance of its support span. It describes invariant behavior as surprising and the computation of a linear-invariant property by Simon(H) as unlikely.
citation_labels: Federico Canale et al., Simon's Algorithm and Symmetric Crypto: Generalizations and Automatized Applications
